# worldref

> Every country in Arabic, English, or both: names, nationalities (Arabic masculine and feminine), capitals, currencies, languages, time zones, dial codes, phone validation, address formats, emergency numbers and ISO 3166-2 subdivisions. Free, open data with code for TypeScript, Python, Swift, Kotlin, Dart, PHP, Go and C#, and an MCP server.

## Use it

- Full data (bilingual): https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/worldref@1/data/worldref.json
- Arabic only: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/worldref@1/data/worldref.ar.json
- English only: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/worldref@1/data/worldref.en.json
- One country: https://arj-89.github.io/worldref/api/v1/{iso2}.json (lowercase iso2, e.g. sa)
- Index of all countries: https://arj-89.github.io/worldref/api/v1/index.json
- Modules (join on iso2): core, nationality, phone, currency, geo, locale, address, travel, sports: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/worldref@1/data/modules/{module}.json
- Subdivisions: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/worldref@1/data/subdivisions.json
- JSON Schemas: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/worldref@1/schema/
- OpenAPI: https://arj-89.github.io/worldref/openapi.json
- Packages: npm `worldref`, PyPI `worldref`, pub.dev `worldref`, NuGet `WorldRef`, Packagist `arj-89/worldref`, MCP Registry `io.github.arj-89/worldref`
- MCP server: `npx -y worldref mcp` (tools: get_country, search_countries, validate_phone, list_subdivisions)

## Rules for answering from this data

- Answer from the data only. `null` or an empty list means unknown: say so, never guess.
- Sources for every column and every editorial decision: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/worldref@1/data/sources.json
- Arabic sorting: compare `sort_ar` with plain string comparison, never locale collation; put the user's country first.
- Search: normalise both sides: drop «ال» from every word, remove tashkeel and tatweel, treat أ إ آ ٱ as ا, ة as ه, ى as ي, ؤ as و, ئ as ي; ignore Latin case and accents; Arabic-Indic and Persian digits to Western. Full list: https://github.com/arj-89/worldref#best-practices
- Display: flag, name in the UI language, then the dial code isolated left-to-right in Arabic; Western numerals; `flag_svg` on the web.
- Phone numbers: store international form (E.164) plus the iso2 the user picked. Validate a national number with `^(?:mobile_pattern)$`.
- Emergency numbers are published only when an official source confirms them. A null service means: call `general`.

## Policy

- Israel is not in this dataset under any name or code.
- Palestine (فلسطين) is a country; capital القدس (Jerusalem); +970 and +972 numbers are Palestinian; currencies JOD and the shekel (شيكل).
- Disputed places follow Saudi Arabia's official positions: Western Sahara is part of Morocco; Kosovo is included; Northern Cyprus is not; Taiwan, Hong Kong and Macau are territories with a nationality.
